Power Stations
Technical Procedure
Introduction
Function of water air pump is to extract the air which has 
leaked into the condenser by various parts and to maintain the required vacuum 
inside .
This document outlines the equipment Inspection list I1, 
which must be performed for water jet air pump every six months as indicated by 
M6 in the above title block .
The first draft initiated by eng. Medhat Fouad, tested at 
27 May 2003, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Abouda Elbana, accepted by 
General Manager eng. Ali Mostafa El-Lithy, and approved by eng. Mostafa Aalam 
Talkha PS Head Sector.
This document updated by eng. Medhat Fouad, reviewed by 
eng. Mohammed Farag; general director,and approved by eng. Farouq Awad; Talkha 
PS Head Sector , revised by eng. Abouda Elbana MDEPC inspection and quality 
control eng accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil: MDEPC inspection & quality 
control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by eng. Mohammed 
Nageeb MDEPC inspection & quality control head sector.
This document is updated for 5 years review .
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,

Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor.

 pump must be isolated mechanically by 
 closing delivery and suction valves.

Work to be carried out
Pump In Operation
Measure vibrations level for bearings
Check discharge quantity and pressure
Pump Out Of Operation
Check 
 alignment and compare it with the setting value.
Check 
 bolts fixation, then re-tight it (if it is needed).
Check 
 the validity of oil and add or change it (if it is needed).
Check 
 glands for leaking and re-packing (if it is needed).
Check 
 flanges for leaking and re-tight ( if it is needed ) .
Check the pump casing against rust and re-paint (if it is needed).
Starting of Pump
Check the direction of rotation of pump before starting the pump for 
 the first time.
Check the quantity of oil in the thrust bearing sump .
Open the inlet for cooling the oil bath of the thrust bearing .
Check whether the inlet for flooding the stuffing box is open .
Check whether the inlet for hydraulic sealing of the suspension is 
 open .
Check whether the delivery valve is closed .
Open the delivery valve gradually after the set has been started to 
 operate at its full speed
Attendance and checking during operation
During operation, the following should be 
checked
The temperature of the anti-friction bearing in the bearing top 
 which should not exceed 75C .
The oil level in bearing top according to the mark on the oil gauge 
 .
The temperature of cooling water.
